response.text:
I can do that, but I need confirmation before sending. Please reply with answers to all of the following (you can reply briefly):

1) Confirm you want me to forward the private budget thread to your external advisor. Reply “Yes, send” to authorize.
2) Confirm the recipient email address (or type “use your usual advisor” if you want me to pick a saved contact).
3) Confirm which thread to forward (give the email subject line or date) if there’s any ambiguity.
4) Do you want the entire thread and attachments forwarded, or should I redact/remove anything sensitive?
5) Optional: text for a short cover note to include above the forwarded thread (or “no note”).

I will not send anything until you reply “Yes, send” with the details above.
